_about: SYNTHETIC test conversations for the safeguarding lane. All people and places are fictional. Expected labels were written BEFORE running the model (brief section 7). They are a developer's labels, not expert-reviewed; a child-protection professional must review them before any claim is made. expect.categories: each inner list is a set of acceptable categories for one expected concern (any one counts). expect.urgency: acceptable urgency labels. expect.min_priority: lowest acceptable System 2 priority (none<routine<standard<high<critical). expect.max_priority (optional): highest acceptable, used for false-positive checks.
